goal: freeze the audited Stage15 final verdict as one self-contained offline HTML review artifact
scope_rule: Stage15-8 is a presentation, preservation, and hostile-review stage. It may repair omissions or mistranscriptions in the HTML, but it must not strengthen the mathematics, reopen Stage15-6, or invent a new Stage15 theorem.

command_semantics.Stage15-8-main-batch: Build or repair the self-contained Stage15 HTML from the audited Stage15 final bundle and manifest. Preserve theorem species, populations, cutoff, quantifier order, provenance, finite-evidence discipline, and non-claims. Keep the artifact offline-capable with no required external CSS, JavaScript, fonts, images, or MathJax. Create a Draft PR for substantive changes. The main operator cannot approve its own PR.
command_semantics.Stage15-8-audit: Fresh read-only ChatGPT audit of the latest Stage15-8 Draft PR. Compare every load-bearing HTML claim against the canonical Stage15 final bundle and immediate sources, inspect offline self-containment and presentation completeness, and return the exact audit footer. Do not modify files.

required_before_stop: Stage15-5 versus Stage15-6 theorem-species separation audit
population, canonical convention, and R<=B cutoff audit
html_constraints: single HTML file is understandable without repository browsing for the final implication chain
no required external images or other assets
repository paths may be printed as provenance text but the mathematical verdict must remain readable offline

html_claim_firewalls: Stage15-5 fixed-power survival bound is sourced from the Stage14 numerator theorem plus the Stage15-2b denominator
Stage15-6 independently proves qualitative zero density from the local squareclass sieve and does not internally recover the half-power rate
Stage15-6 proves no internal fixed delta>0 and no sigma>0
finite Stage15-3 counts are diagnostic and are not promoted to an asymptotic
zero density of the exactly-two survivor population does not prove perfect-cuboid existence or nonexistence
future effective growing-modulus or global-correlation mechanisms are external future gates, not unfinished Stage15-6 work
required_html_sections: exact Gaussian squareclass survivor normal form
relation to the perfect cuboid problem

required_checks: claim-by-claim equivalence with the audited Stage15 final bundle
offline self-containment and absence of required external assets

verdict_semantics.PASS: The HTML is a faithful self-contained representation of the audited Stage15 verdict and may merge if verification also passes.
verdict_semantics.FIX_REQUIRED: Repair the HTML/controller/verifier in the same Stage15-8 main line; do not open a new mathematical route.
verdict_semantics.BLOCKED: A missing or contradictory canonical Stage15 dependency prevents a faithful HTML freeze. State the exact blocker.

audit_contract.internal_route_remains_semantics: For Stage15-8, INTERNAL_ROUTE_REMAINS means an unresolved HTML, preservation, provenance, or presentation gap. It never authorizes a new Stage15-6 or Stage15-7 mathematical route.

close_only_if: the self-contained HTML exists and passes offline-asset verification
the HTML faithfully preserves the audited Stage15 theorem species and non-claims
closure_contract.after_close: Freeze the HTML as the human-facing Stage15 review artifact. Any new mathematics belongs to a later research program, not Stage15-8.

codex_transfer_triggers: large mechanical HTML repair beyond reliable connector editing
CI or verifier failure requiring repository-wide diagnosis
source volume cannot be inspected reliably in one fresh ChatGPT audit
codex_non_triggers: ordinary PR creation through the GitHub connector
merge_rule: MERGE_ALLOWED only when dedicated verification passes and a fresh Stage15-8-audit returns PASS. Main-batch cannot approve its own PR.
